newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti stock falls on 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti stock falls on 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in Italian information technology group Olivetti were nearly four percent down on the Milan bourse by midsession on worries over losses and slumping sales in 1996, traders said.
The stock opened nearly four percent up after it announced a pre-tax loss for 1996 but faded quickly as the session wore on.

Olivetti gave preliminary 1996 results after the market closed on Wednesday, saying its pre-tax loss would be around 800 billion lire while annual sales slumped 16 percent to 8.27 trillion lire from 1995 levels.
At 1150 GMT, the share was quoted at 3.99 percent at 625 lire after touching a session low of 620 lire. Olivetti was the most traded stock with over 39 million shares changing hands.
Traders said the 1996 loss figure was more or less in line with expectations but the market did not welcome the drop in turnover.

"Also, we don't know anything about margins and the announced loss figure is pre-tax so the net loss could be greater even if Olivetti manages to sell off other activities like its Technost automated systems unit," one fund analyst said.
"However, Olivetti has risen quite a bit from the lows of 435 lire seen in October and so a settling back is not too surprising," one dealer said.
